decision.reason: A source-final subject-style when in a declared UInt64-returning function kept default-Int arm types, so final return reconciliation left the subject as the function result instead of the selected arm. The exponentBit helper consequently returned its bit index, field inversion failed, X25519 became non-commutative, and QUIC AEAD returned Err0. Declared integer results now seed only the actual source-final direct literal or complete subject-when, preserving a later top-level result. Normalize retained historical verification observations to the existing record contract. Original JSON and terminal outputs remain preserved unchanged. Recorded baseline timeout/cancellation and orphan evidence is retained, not relabeled as current success. No current input compatibility, whole-goal acceptance, new test execution or speed claim.
